instruction: Change the font to Courier New throughout the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font to Courier New for all text. Uses existing compare_font_names metric which verifies all runs have the expected font name.

llm_judge_reasons: The compare_font_names metric only checks font in doc.paragraphs (body text)
Instruction requires font change 'throughout the document' but metric does NOT verify text in tables, headers, footers, text boxes, or shapes
The metric will incorrectly pass even if tables/headers/footers retain their original font
Incomplete coverage: only body paragraph runs are checked, missing other document elements that may contain text
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Extend compare_font_names to also iterate through doc.tables and check font in all table cells
Add checks for headers: iterate doc.sections and check section.header.paragraphs
Add checks for footers: iterate doc.sections and check section.footer.paragraphs
Consider checking text in shapes/text boxes if the document contains such elements
Alternative: Simplify the instruction to only require font change in body paragraphs (not 'throughout the document')

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric compare_font_names second parameter type (List) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
